(धन या कल्याण की छाप बनाए रखना; अधिक खुश, कम गरीब, आदि होने का नाटक करना, क्योंकि आप नहीं चाहते कि लोगों को पता चले कि आपकी स्थिति कितनी खराब है) • For Example - They were very unhappily married but **kept up appearances** for the sake of their children. • The given sentence tries to convey that the marriage of the couple was not working well but still they were maintaining an expression of well-being. • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.** 2f:T431, Here the correct answer is **Happy and energetic.**

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

The interview will be conducted **__by 9 a.m. till 11 a.m.__**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'from 9 a.m to 11 a.m'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m.'** should be used instead of **'by 9 a.m. till 11 a.m.'**
 
• ‘**From**’ is used to show the place, direction, or time that somebody/something starts or started.
 
 
• *Example: I work **from** 8.30 am **to** 5.00 pm every day.*
 
 
 
• Similarly, in the given sentence **9 a.m.** is the time when the interview started.
 
• '**From**' is followed by '**to**' when we talk about time.
 
• Hence, ‘**from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m.**’ is the most appropriate answer.

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The interview will be conducted **from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• इधर,** 'from 9 a.m. till 11 a.m.'** **'by 9 a.m. to 11 a.m' **के बजाय इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• '**From**' का प्रयोग उस स्थान, दिशा या समय को दर्शाने के लिए किया जाता है जिससे कोई व्यक्ति/कुछ शुरू होता है।
 
 
• Example: I work **from **8.30 am **to **5.00pm every day.
 
 
 
• इसी तरह दिए गए वाक्य में **9 a.m.** बजे वह समय है जब साक्षात्कार शुरू होगा।
 
• जब हम समय की बात करते हैं तो '**from**' के बाद '**to**' आता है।
 
• इसलिए, **'from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m.' **सबसे उपयुक्त उत्तर है।

questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

My brother said to me, "Have you read the newspaper today?"

options.text: My brother asked me if I had read the newspaper that day.
My brother asked me if you have read the newspaper today.
My brother asked me have you read the newspaper today.
My brother asked me if I had read the newspaper today.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'My brother asked me if I had read the newspaper that day.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the question, we have to change it into Indirect Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• In the given sentence the reporting verb has an object. Hence, 'said to' will be changed into 'asked'. 
 
• Comma and inverted commas will be removed. 
 
• The conjunction 'if' will be added.
 
• '**you**' will be changed into '**I**' because the** second-person** **pronouns** are changed according to the **object** of the **reporting** **verb**.
 
• **'have read'** will be changed into **'had read'.**
 
• The adverb '**today**' will be changed into **'that day'.**

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *My brother asked me if I had read the newspaper that day.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **Direct Speech** में है। प्रश्न के अनुसार, हमें इसे **Indirect Speech** में बदलना होगा।
 
• परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में **Reporting Verb** में **Object** है। इसलिए, **'said to' **को '**asked**' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• अल्पविराम और उल्टे अल्पविराम हटा दिए जाएंगे।
 
• **Conjunction** '**if**' जोड़ा जाएगा।
 
• '**you**' को '**I**' में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि **Reporting Verb** के **Object** के अनुसार **Second person** के **Pronoun** बदल दिए जाते हैं।
 
• **'have read' **को** 'had read'** में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• क्रिया विशेषण '**today**' को** 'that day' **में बदल दिया जाएगा।

questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.**

A. The town of Lustenau in Austria claims to have built a world record-breaking bonfire.

B. The structure took three months to build but collapsed in less than half an hour last Saturday evening.

C. Embers from the big fire fell onto nearby market traders, but local fire crews were on hand to make sure that everyone was safe.

D. According to the organizers, the pyre reached as high as 60 meters.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'ADBC'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a **para jumbled** question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
• **Sentence A** will be the starting line because it contains the main idea of the para jumble i.e.the town of Lustenau that built a world record-breaking bonfire.
 
• However, **Sentence D** states that the pyre reached as high as 60 meters. So, **D** will follow **A**.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of Pyre:-
 
 
• **Pyre **- a heap of combustible material, especially one for burning a corpse as part of a funeral ceremony.
 
 
 
• Further,** Sentence B** states that the structure took three months to build but collapsed in less than half an hour & **Sentence C** states that Embers from the big fire fell onto nearby market traders. So, **C** will follow **B**.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of Embers:-
 
 
• **Embers **- a small piece of burning or glowing coal or wood in a dying fire.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct sequence:
 
 
• **A**. The town of Lustenau in Austria claims to have built a world record-breaking bonfire.
 
• **D**. According to the organizers, the pyre reached as high as 60 meters.
 
• **B**. The structure took three months to build but collapsed in less than half an hour last Saturday evening.
 
• **C**. Embers from the big fire fell onto nearby market traders, but local fire crews were on hand to make sure that everyone was safe.

 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *The town of Lustenau in Austria claims to have built a world record-breaking bonfire. According to the organizers, the pyre reached as high as 60 meters. The structure took three months to build but collapsed in less than half an hour last Saturday evening. Embers from the big fire fell onto nearby market traders, but local fire crews were on hand to make sure that everyone was safe.*
